slice: Fourth fill of uncovered pre-2020 off-road years from model-year spec and change listings: KTM 250/300 XC, Husqvarna FE 450/501, TE 150, TX 125, Yamaha WR250F (knowledge push 2026-11)

records.statement: For 2013 the 250 XC got a revised clutch, optimised engine-to-frame braces, new US cross-country settings in the 48 mm closed-cartridge fork, a lower triple clamp 80 g lighter, a 25 mm rear axle in place of the 20 mm one, and restyled bodywork with a rib-free front fender. It is a 249 cc (66.4 x 72 mm) two-stroke with kick and electric start, a six-speed gearbox and hydraulic clutch. Travel is 300 mm front and 317 mm rear, the seat is 992 mm and it weighs about 229 lb without fuel. US list price $8,199.

For 2013 the 300 XC got the new DDS clutch (a single diaphragm spring with a steel basket and thin steel plates), a V-Force reed cage, new US cross-country settings in the 48 mm closed-cartridge fork, a lighter lower triple clamp, a 25 mm rear axle in place of the 20 mm one and restyled bodywork. It is a 293 cc (72 x 72 mm) two-stroke with kick and electric start and a six-speed gearbox. Travel is 300 mm front and 317 mm rear and it weighs about 229 lb without fuel. US list price $8,299.

For 2015 the 250 XC got a 4CS fork 8 mm longer with a new hydraulic stop, new cartridge pistons and a 20 N/mm chamber spring (was 18), a re-valved shock with 4 mm more stroke on a new linkage with a higher starting rate, a 22 mm front axle in place of the 26 mm one, a lighter clutch basket, shorter starter gearing with a new 3 Ah battery and a redesigned reed housing. Final drive is 13/50, the tank holds 10 litres, the seat is 992 mm and it weighs 103.9 kg without fuel.

The 2016 250 XC kept the 2015 chassis and engine with detail changes: rubber damping in the upper triple clamp and bar mounts (two bar positions) to cut vibration, a larger bar pad and lighter wave brake discs. It runs a Keihin PWK 38 carburettor, six-speed gearbox, kick and electric start, DDS clutch with Brembo hydraulics, a 48 mm WP 4CS fork and linkage shock (300 / 317 mm travel), a 10-litre tank and weighs 100.7 kg without fuel.

records.topic: FE 450 and FE 501 2016 updates and specs
records.statement: For 2016 the FE 450 and FE 501 got a 22 mm front axle in place of the 26 mm one, 22 mm offset triple clamps with revised front geometry, new brakes (260 mm front, 220 mm rear), lighter spokes, a lighter clutch basket and a grippier seat cover. Both have a six-speed gearbox, DDS clutch with Brembo hydraulics, a 48 mm WP 4CS fork (11.8 in travel), a linkage shock (13 in), a 2.25-gallon tank and a 38.2 in seat. The maker lists 53 hp and 248.7 lb without fuel for the FE 450 and 58 hp and 249.8 lb for the FE 501. List prices $9,999 and $10,199.

The 2017 TE 150 has an all-new, more compact two-stroke engine (58 x 54.4 mm) with a redesigned power valve and crankcases about 600 g lighter, electric start as standard with a kick backup, and a 38 mm Mikuni TMX in place of the Keihin. The frame is 0.6 kg lighter, the composite subframe 1 kg lighter, and it uses the WP Xplor 48 fork (300 mm travel) and a linkage shock (330 mm). It has a six-speed gearbox, Magura hydraulic clutch, a 10-litre tank, a 960 mm seat and weighs 92.0 kg without fuel.

The 2017 TX 125 is a 124.8 cc (54.0 x 54.5 mm) kick-start two-stroke with a six-speed gearbox and hydraulic clutch. It uses the WP Xplor 48 fork with preload adjusters (300 mm travel) and a linkage shock (330 mm), a 10-litre (2.64-gallon) tank, a 960 mm seat, a 21-inch front and 18-inch rear wheel, and weighs 92.2 kg dry.

The 2011 WR250F is a five-titanium-valve DOHC 250 (12.5:1) with a 37 mm Keihin FCR flat-slide, electric start with a kick backup and a five-speed gearbox, with a 48 mm Kayaba cartridge fork (11.8 in travel) and linkage shock (12.2 in). Seat height 38.6 in, 2.1-gallon tank, 256 lb wet by the US spec table. US list price $6,850.

The 2013 WR250F is a five-titanium-valve DOHC 249 cc engine (12.5:1) with a 37 mm Keihin FCR flat-slide, electric start with a kick backup and a five-speed gearbox, with a 48 mm Kayaba cartridge fork (11.8 in travel) and linkage shock (12.2 in). Seat height 38.6 in, 2.1-gallon tank, 254 lb wet by the US spec. US list price $6,990.
